```{python}
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, ".")

import warnings

import yaml

import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np
from utils.helpers import load_processed_data
from utils.helpers import load_metrics


with open("_params.yml") as f:
    params = yaml.safe_load(f)

st_dict = load_processed_data(params)
obs_dict = load_metrics(params["methods"])
```

## Comparative metrics table

```{python}
rows = []
for method, st in st_dict.items():
    obs = st.sdata.tables["table"].obs
    uns = st.sdata.tables["table"].uns

    row = {"Method": method}

    # Baseline
    if "num_cells" in uns:
        row["# Cells"] = uns["num_cells"]
    if "perc_unassigned_transcripts" in uns:
        row["% Unassigned (↓)"] = round(uns["perc_unassigned_transcripts"], 2)
    if "transcript_count" in obs:
        row["Median transcripts/cell (↑)"] = round(obs["transcript_count"].median(), 1)
    if "gene_count" in obs:
        row["Median genes/cell (↑)"] = round(obs["gene_count"].median(), 1)

    # Morphology
    if "cell_area" in obs:
        row["Median cell area"] = round(obs["cell_area"].median(), 1)
    if "circularity" in obs:
        row["Median circularity"] = round(obs["circularity"].median(), 3)

    # Contamination
    if "iou" in obs:
        row["Median IoU (↑)"] = round(obs["iou"].median(), 3)
    if "border_admixture_score" in obs:
        row["Median border admixture (↓)"] = round(obs["border_admixture_score"].median(), 3)

    rows.append(row)

df_summary = pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index("Method")
df_summary.T
```

## Radar chart

```{python}
#| echo: false
metrics = {
    "Transcript\ncount":   ("transcript_count", True),   # higher is better, no invert
    "Gene\ncount":         ("gene_count", True),
    "IoU":                 ("iou", True),
    "Low\nadmixture":      ("border_admixture_score", True),  # invert
    "Circularity":         ("circularity", True),
}

method_scores = {}

for metric_label, (col, invert) in metrics.items():
    vals = {}
    for method, obs in obs_dict.items():
        if col in obs.columns:
            vals[method] = obs[col].median()
    if vals:
        min_v, max_v = min(vals.values()), max(vals.values())
        for method, v in vals.items():
            norm = (v - min_v) / (max_v - min_v) if max_v != min_v else 0.5
            if invert:
                norm = 1 - norm
            method_scores.setdefault(method, {})[metric_label] = norm

labels = list(metrics.keys())
n = len(labels)
angles = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, n, endpoint=False).tolist()
angles += angles[:1]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 6), subplot_kw=dict(polar=True))
colors = sns.color_palette("Set2", len(obs_dict))

for (method, scores), color in zip(method_scores.items(), colors):
    values = [scores.get(l, 0) for l in labels]
    values += values[:1]
    ax.plot(angles, values, label=method, color=color, linewidth=2)
    ax.fill(angles, values, alpha=0.1, color=color)

ax.set_xticks(angles[:-1])
ax.set_xticklabels(labels, size=11)
ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax.set_yticks([0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0])
ax.set_yticklabels(["0.25", "0.5", "0.75", "1.0"], size=8)
ax.legend(loc="upper right", bbox_to_anchor=(1.3, 1.1))
ax.set_title("Method comparison (normalized metrics)", pad=20)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
